caption: Why circles make bad geofences and hexagons don't. Search geminislabs.com for Nexus.

slides.screen: Your geofence is the wrong shape
slides.say: Most geofences are circles. And that's exactly why your tracking app keeps crying wolf.
Draw a circle around a warehouse and you either cut off the loading dock or swallow half the street.
Hexagons fit together with no gaps or overlaps, so a zone can follow the real shape of a place.
Every neighboring cell sits at the same distance from the center, so entering and leaving mean the same thing everywhere.
That's why Nexus uses hexagonal geofences. Exact zones, fewer false alarms, alerts you can actually trust.
Check it out at geminislabs dot com. Follow for more.
